question: Why did customer churn spike in Q3 2025?
plan: Verify the churn rate and total number of churned customers in Q3 2025 compared to previous quarters to measure the size of the spike.
Analyze the churned customers in Q3 2025 by their geographic region to see if the spike is concentrated in a specific area.
Analyze the churned customers in Q3 2025 by their support ticket volume and resolution status prior to churning to determine if customer service issues contributed.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', churn_date) || '-Q' || ((STRFTIME('%m', churn_date) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS churn_quarter, COUNT(customer_id) AS churned_count FROM customers WHERE NOT churn_date IS NULL GROUP BY churn_quarter ORDER BY churn_quarter LIMIT 500

WITH quarters AS (SELECT DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y', signup_date) || '-Q' || ((STRFTIME('%m', signup_date) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS q FROM customers UNION SELECT DISTINCT STRFTIME('%Y', churn_date) || '-Q' || ((STRFTIME('%m', churn_date) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS q FROM customers WHERE NOT churn_date IS NULL), q_base AS (SELECT q.q AS quarter, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers AS c WHERE c.signup_date <= q.q || '-12-31' AND (c.churn_date IS NULL OR c.churn_date >= q.q)) AS active_start_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers AS c WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', c.churn_date) || '-Q' || ((STRFTIME('%m', c.churn_date) - 1) / 3 + 1) = q.q) AS churned_count FROM quarters AS q WHERE NOT q.q IS NULL) SELECT quarter, churned_count, active_start_customers, CASE WHEN active_start_customers > 0 THEN CAST(churned_count AS REAL) / active_start_customers ELSE 0 END AS churn_rate FROM q_base ORDER BY quarter LIMIT 500

SELECT r.region_name, r.country, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS churned_count FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE c.churn_date >= '2025-07-01' AND c.churn_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name, r.country ORDER BY churned_count DESC LIMIT 500

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment, r.region_name, c.churn_date, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN t.resolved_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN t.severity = 'critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critical_tickets FROM customers AS c JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN support_tickets AS t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND t.created_date <= c.churn_date WHERE c.churn_date >= '2025-07-01' AND c.churn_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment, r.region_name, c.churn_date ORDER BY total_tickets DESC, unresolved_tickets DESC LIMIT 500
